children: USD.AI schedules a CHIP supply unlock for August 2027. The release makes at least 147.12 million tokens available to investors and team members. The announced minimum is equal to 7.36% of CHIP's circulating supply.
The unlock is part of CHIP's monthly vesting schedule. It removes the vesting restriction on this batch of tokens, so investors and team members can sell the CHIP they receive from the release.

title: USD.AI: CHIP Supply Unlock Releases at Least 147.12 Million Tokens - Aug 2027
